scope.inventory_correction: The frozen 57-fragment inventory is 21 44b6 plus 36 6bba, not 36 44b6. Arm C must authenticate and inspect exactly the 21 train__44b6_*.csv identities and fail closed if any 6bba identity enters.

mechanism.hypothesis: A pre-existing, held-44b6 cache of physical intensity summaries can expose parent-to-two-daughter intensity redistribution strongly enough to realize high-precision forks.
required_cached_observables: parent physical-intensity mass or equivalent fixed voxel summary at t
each proposed daughter's physical-intensity mass or equivalent fixed voxel summary at t+1
cache-level node identities sufficient to bind those summaries to observed graph nodes
forbidden_substitutions: raw image or raw archive reads
treating V45 latent embeddings as additive physical intensity
using a fit105 cache for held-44b6 identities it does not contain

selection_rule_if_and_only_if_cache_is_a.candidate_universe: all label-safe parent-to-two-branch motifs in all 21 frozen 44b6 graphs
selection_rule_if_and_only_if_cache_is_a.score: fixed physical-intensity redistribution residual from cached parent and daughter summaries
selection_rule_if_and_only_if_cache_is_a.policy: high precision, abstain unless all required cached values and node bindings are present

candidate_1.adequacy_condition: must cover all 21 held-44b6 identities and expose the required cached observables

candidate_2.adequacy_condition: coverage alone is insufficient; the payload must expose physical intensity summaries, not only coordinates, confidence scores, and learned latent association features

candidate_3.adequacy_condition: must cover all 21 held-44b6 identities and expose the required cached observables

preprediction_cache_audit.decision_rule: If no already-existing frozen cache both covers exactly all 21 held-44b6 identities and exposes the required physical-intensity summaries, emit FAIL_CLOSED_NO_ADEQUATE_FROZEN_INTENSITY_CACHE. Emit no predictions, read no target, run no N1/scorer evaluation, and do not fall back to raw data.
